headline: German Metalworking Union and Employers Reach Wage Deal Amid Industrial Crisis
summary: German trade union IG Metall and employers in the metal and electrical engineering sectors reached a framework salary deal following marathon talks held against an industrial crisis backdrop.
why: Metal and electrical engineering forms the backbone of Germany's manufacturing export industry, with wage agreements setting baseline labor costs.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Sector-wide wage agreements establish labor operating costs for primary industrial employers.
